evidence.detail: `load_rotation_summary()` returns only `(runs, num_cards)` — no per-check summary counts exposed
_rotation table already stores `hit_in_last_run BOOL` per card, so 'in this check' count is a simple COUNT WHERE hit_in_last_run=1
Template shows runs/percent/num_cards but has no 'in this check' or 'eliminated this check' line

triage.fix_sketch: 1) Extend `load_rotation_summary()` in `decksite/data/rotation.py` to also return `in_this_check` (COUNT WHERE hit_in_last_run=1) and `eliminated_this_check` (COUNT WHERE status='Eliminated' AND hit_in_last_run=0 AND hits + @total_runs - @runs_completed + 1 >= @hits_required). 2) Expose those counts in `decksite/views/rotation.py`. 3) Add a line to `decksite/templates/rotation.mustache` showing the summary. ~30-40 lines total, no schema change.
triage.notes: The _rotation cache already computes all necessary columns (hit_in_last_run, status, hits). The 'eliminated this check' definition may need minor product clarification but a reasonable approximation is straightforward.
